headline: What Is a Heat Pump and How Does It Work?
subheading: A heat pump is an air conditioner that also runs in reverse. Here's the simple physics of how it pulls heat out of freezing outdoor air, and why that makes it three to five times more efficient than a furnace.
seoTitle: What Is a Heat Pump and How Does It Work? | Heat Pump Guides
description: A heat pump is an air conditioner that also runs in reverse. How it pulls heat from cold outdoor air, the four main parts, and why it beats 100% efficiency.
